_doc: Shared threshold policy file: vdiff reads the global/region/fuzz ceiling block; vcompare reads the ssim/deltaE2000/structural starting + ceiling block. Ceilings hard-reject violating regions JSONs via HALT-fork (vdiff exit 2, vcompare exit 2). Threshold-UP (loosening) requires --allow-threshold-up; never set by make targets. Threshold-DOWN (tightening) is silent-allowed. Dispatch 5.17 calibrated against dispatch 5.16 visual-mockup-match measured floor; absolute floor 0.45 honored.
